title: CX: one-line reviewer packets for all open builder 4 PRs
public_pr_body:
CX adds one line for each of the 23 open builder-4 PRs to tests/REVIEW-PACKETS-NEXT.md: full captured head SHA plus the specific reviewer check. The prior 148-packet inventory is preserved byte-for-byte; capture metadata and its prefix hash are in tests/review-packets/BUILDER-4-CX-SNAPSHOT.json.

The CX self-row records the already-open draft head before the packet commit; it cannot contain this eventual commit hash. **Final CX publication head: a0044d2c87f3e741470ed70a5e16cf359c60f7ae**. Use this final head for reviewing CX and refresh other heads if they move.

Final handover for comparison/push, CR–CV/BA review, CW and CX: tests/HANDOVER-BUILDER-4-CX.md. Cross-review draft #314 now includes current CV #315 and BA #317; CW replacement papers are #316.

Validation: 23 unique open builder-4 PRs, full 40-character snapshot heads, one specific check each, original prefix hash/bytes preserved, git diff --check. Metadata/documentation only; no unit/runtime result or SAFE verdict is inferred. Actual sign-offs and database/provider/browser/restore/manual checks stay open. No Ready label, main merge, production SQL or deployment.
